en: Wearing rubber-soled slippers increases friction to prevent you from slipping on wet bathroom tiles.
Never touch electrical switches with wet hands because water is a good conductor of electricity.
Wearing light-colored cotton clothes in the Philippines reflects sunlight and helps keep your body cooler.
Listening to loud headphones for too long can permanently damage the delicate hair cells in your inner ear.
Looking directly at the sun without certified eclipse glasses can cause permanent damage to your eye's retina.
Never swallow small button magnets because they can attract each other inside your intestines and cause severe tissue damage.
Using a wheelbarrow to carry heavy soil reduces the effort force needed to lift the load.
Wearing a bicycle helmet protects your brain because gravity accelerates your head rapidly toward the hard ground.
Eating rice provides your body with chemical energy that your cells convert into kinetic energy for playing.
Wearing a seatbelt stops your body from continuing to move forward when a car suddenly brakes.
Always use an oven mitt to hold a hot metal pan because metal conducts thermal energy rapidly.
Unplugging appliances by pulling the plastic plug prevents the internal wires from breaking and causing a short circuit.
